blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Twelve members of the Bangsamoro Islamic Freedom Fighters (BIFF) surrendered to the government on Thursday in Maguindanao del Sur, the military said. The former extremists used to operate in the adjoining towns of Datu Abdullah Sangki, Datu Saudi Ampatuan, Shariff Aguak, Ampatuan and Datu Unsay. They also turned over 12 firearms. During the ceremony, 14 other unlicensed firearms were also turned over by civilians and local officials to the soldiers. These actions are in line with the government’s Small Arms and Light Weapons (SALW) Management Program. Lt. Col. Loqui Marco, commander of the 90th Infantry Battalion (90IB), said […]...
